component.name: Vega
component.summary: Read, write and zap on Nostr

description.p: Vega is a desktop client for Nostr, a decentralized social network where you own your identity, your content and your social graph. No company can delete your account or censor your posts.

Long-form writing and reading is a first-class feature, not an afterthought. Alongside the social feed, Vega gives you a proper markdown article editor and reader for publishing and following long-form content.

ul.li: Long-form articles (NIP-23) with a markdown editor and reader
Lightning zaps over Nostr Wallet Connect
Web-of-trust filtering to keep the feed trustworthy
An optional built-in relay, so your notes stay available locally
Private keys stored in your system keyring

screenshot.caption: The main feed with notes, reactions and zaps
Writing an article in the markdown editor

description.p: Adds relay authentication (NIP-42) with a privacy scope setting, so relays that gate messages behind authentication now work.
Remote-signer sessions reconnect reliably after a restart, and the diagnostics log is now opt-in and capped.
Browse without signing in, a clearer relay indicator, and fewer relay connections per refresh.
Relay list changes apply immediately, and a new Relay reach switch confines Vega to your configured relays.
Desktop notifications for incoming direct messages, naming the sender only — never the message content.
Remote signer login works with spec-compliant bunkers, proxy DNS leaks fixed, and the release pipeline hardened.
Linux keys now persist via the system secret service, including inside sandboxed installs.
Fixes a crash in the Support view and adds an optional network proxy (HTTP/SOCKS5), including Tor.
Internal maintenance release aligning the application identifier with the project domain.
